title: pulse laser from 0 fires every 60 ticks until the cutout refuses and cooling lets it resume
derivation: One gate call per tick 1..horizon with energy 1e9, range 0, accuracy 0 and onTarget true; draws taken equal shots. Cooling is fmaxf(t - (float)(WEAPON_COOLING_FACTOR x delta_t), 0.0f) at the top of every update (ShipEntity.m:2214-2218), i.e. t = fround(max(fround(t - c), 0)) with c = fround(6 x 1/120) = 0.05000000074505806, BEFORE the behaviour fires, so the gate reads the cooled value; a shot adds fround(7) = 7 (9971-9973). The pulse laser's period is round(fround(0.5) x 120) = 60 ticks. Start: temperature 0 at tick 1, never fired, so the first shot is at tick 1 and the next ones at 1 + 60k. Per period the weapon gains 7 and loses 60 x 0.05000000074505806 = 3.0000000447034836: net 4.0000 per shot. The temperature read before shot n grows by that net each period until a read reaches 217.60000610351562: the last shot before the refusal is at tick 3181 (read 211.99356079101562) and leaves 218.99356079101562, so the very next tick already reads 218.9435577392578 >= 217.60000610351562: the first refusal is tick 3182 (heat is checked before the timer, 9935-9947). Cooling at 0.05000000074505806 per tick brings the read below the cutout at tick 3209 (217.59347534179688) while the timer opens at tick 3241 (3181 + 60). The first tick the gate fires again is tick 3241, bound by the timer, with read 215.99337768554688. 55 shots, each one draw.
